_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has moved ±2+ points in 0 of 55 windows — this is a confirmed coil with no breaker visible, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until either ETF flows>90+momentum>70 sustained 24h pushes toward Hope or VIX>85+funding<35 breaks down toward Panic.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — Analyst forward calls Disbelief/HOLD; Narrative implies Denial/UP. I side with the Analyst's HOLD direction based on the 0% movement base rate, but anchor the phase at Denial per the Narrative's accumulation-bottom framing and the ±1 rung rule from the lower score band.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds within 32-46 band for next 12h window with funding 50-60 and VIX drifting 65-75 — coil persistence confirms HOLD
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks ±3 points with volume: VIX>85+funding<35 sends it down to Panic/Anxiety, or ETF flows>90+momentum>70 sustained 24h sends it up to Hope
